_comment: Edit decision list — Real World 'The Mission' trailer. Machine-readable source of truth for TRAILER-PLAN.md §3/§7. Consumed by build-animatic.py. Timing in seconds at fps below. 'recapture' marks shots that MUST be re-cut from live game footage before ship; stills are pre-production only.

shots.note: Cold open. Feed line types on black. Audio: room tone, espresso fades up.

shots.card: A neighborhood in San Francisco.
shots.note: Top-down dawn over the café block. Slow drift.

shots.card: Twenty-eight people live here.
shots.note: Street-follow behind a resident on 24th St. Ship version needs a walking pawn.

shots.card: They work. They fall in love. They keep secrets.
shots.note: Dolores Park overhead — palms, paths, drifting pawns.

shots.card: None of them know you're watching.
shots.note: Director-mode low orbit: rooftops, water towers, long shadows. First music swell.

shots.card: Inside, the day is already moving.
shots.note: v52 interior (metric-projection rebuild, art-v52): inside Mudhaus Coffee — the watcher premise indoors. Crop removes top bar, Jules CONTROLLED card, bottom strip; venue plaque is a parody name and stays.

lines: 06:14  Vic unboxed a shipment at Auerbach Hardware.

shots.card: Watching is free. Always.
shots.note: Public feed overlay, entries ticking. Ship version = real feed UI capture.

shots.card: Want to reach in? File a request.
shots.note: Request card fills on screen; approve tick. Sound: held breath, first thunder.

shots.card: Weather. Events. A character of your own.
shots.note: S4 framing repeated in rain — hard dry→wet cut is the money beat. Sim supports weather override (GS_WX_OVR).

shots.card: Drive the character you hired — only yours.
shots.note: Possession handoff: card flips AI→YOU mid-shot. Accuracy-critical: hired character only.

shots.card: When time's up, the sim takes the wheel back.
shots.note: Timer drains; graceful handoff. Pawn keeps walking — no stutter.

lines: @wren_44      rain over the park, 2 h        ran — public
@northbeach   hired a new resident           queued — refunded
shots.card: Every move is public. The audience sees everything.
shots.note: Request-feed montage WITH attribution — transparency is the feature.
Night falls — sodium pools, one lit window (v15+ lamp engine). Music resolves.

shots.note: Window opens, the event runs (bookable events map to the street_event action). Ship cut needs the live crowd beat.

thumbnails.note: The watcher: darkened director shot, red REC dot, small title. Sells the Truman-Show premise.
The handoff: same street shot split down the middle, AI | YOU. Sells the possession hook — hired character only at ship. Name tags redact-blurred so AI|YOU can't read as possessing a main.
The block at dusk: night grade, wordmark only. Quietest option; best for press embeds.
The inside: café interior under the REC bug — we watch them indoors too. HUD-free crop; Mudhaus plaque is a parody name.
